donor_bank.rule: rank by the official oracle, keep the FIRST molecule of each distinct Bemis-Murcko scaffold. Target-blind: the dedup key sees no reference.
donor_bank.why_this_rule: Max-min structural spread was tried FIRST and failed: it selects outliers rather than sweeping scaffold families, needed a 200-molecule pool to reach the thioxanthene core at all, and at bank size 16 dropped troglitazone's ring-signature coverage 9 -> 7. Scaffold coverage reaches thiothixene's rank-41 donor at bank size 40 while consulting no deeper than rank 44.
donor_bank.smallness_is_the_point: This is NOT 'widen to K=5000'. Every bank consults oracle rank <= 46. The repair is to stop spending the bank on repeated scaffolds.

initialization_bank.why: No scaffold or ring-signature coverage gain at 16 molecules, and troglitazone's ring-signature coverage fell. Initialization is therefore LEFT UNCHANGED; only the donor pool moves. Recorded rather than retuned until it passed.

adopted: donor reservoir only, behind --donor-reservoir; initialization untouched
